title: First bands and the Lee Collins record band
summary: He names his first band (Willa Phillips) and others, then the Lee Collins band's recording personnel, drummers and a drummer called Rachel.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was the first band you played with?

My first band was a band called Willa Phillips. Then I played with Bill Fletcher, Lawrence, Tocco, T. Creighton. Oh man, I played with so bad. Way back there. Way back there. I can't remember all of them cats I played with. Yeah, a long time ago. Yeah, a long time ago. I played with all of them bands around here then, man. That was pretty good. That was pretty good. I got to get myself. That was pretty good.

So you played with Lee Collins too, Goodwilded. Lee Collins, yeah. Yeah. That's the band that you made a record with? Huh? That's the band you made a record with? Yeah, I made the camera record with them. Who was in that band when you made a record?
Morgan, Albert Morton. Morgan, Albert Morton. What did Martin play?
What? What did Martin play? Drums. Oh, you ever said drums?

Oh man, I can't remember. That had been so long. I played with all of them. Joe Rochelle was on piano, though. I remember that. All of them people was dead, not what I'm talking about. Yeah, he was dead. Who played band you? Who played band you? I think Sills. Sills. He named Sills. He played on the record? Yeah. He named Sills. He was some dude. Daniel Barker, one of them.

Didn't you tell me something about them having different drummers in that band, Lars? Did you change, did this fellow Martin play with the band all the time? Yeah. The drum player. Martin? Didn't you have different drum players in the band? You changed drums? My first band? No, in Lee Collins' band. Did they have the same drum player all the time?

No, no, no. My drum player, he died, he died, Roy Evans. Oh yeah? Yeah. Well, he must be Lee Collins first? He was good boy. He was really good. He was really good. He just died. No, not Lee. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little while ago.
Did you ever know a drummer called Rachel? Rachel?
Rachel? Mm-hmm. You got to think I know him.
You know his whole name? Huh? You know his whole name? No. Did they just call him Rachel? Yeah, I was called him. Yeah, yeah, right.
Who did he play with? He played uptown. He played bands around there, uptown, uptown there.
